Title: Senior Freight Data Analyst
Company: Fictional Logistics Inc.
Location: Remote
Contact: careers@example.com

About the Role:
We are seeking a Senior Freight Data Analyst to optimize routing, carrier allocation, and operational efficiency across our shipping network.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain SQL models and data pipelines for logistics metrics.
- Build executive and operational dashboards in Tableau.
- Collaborate with dispatch and warehouse teams to identify supply chain bottlenecks.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of data analytics experience in freight, supply chain, or retail logistics.
- Expert proficiency in SQL and Python.
- Proven experience with business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI).
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes cluster management for data workflows (Required).
